fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides comprehensive support through six key components, including integrated village development under Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana, development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups, support to Tribal Research Institutes, and Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarships.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Scholarships for Higher Education for Young Achievers Scheme (SHREYAS)  (OBC & Others)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure the educational empowerment of OBC and EBC students. Through this scheme, fellowships and interest subsidies on overseas education loans are provided to eligible beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: BSR Fellowship Scheme for Science Students - UGC
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide opportunities to meritorious candidates to undertake advanced studies and research leading to Ph.D. degrees in sciences.

fields.schemeName: National Service Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the National Service Scheme (NSS) is to develop the personality and character of students through voluntary community service. The scheme aims to promote social responsibility, leadership, national integration, and a spirit of selfless service among youth.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹500/- is provided to severely disabled (with a disability of 80% and above) and multi-disabled individuals aged 18 to 79 years who are living below the poverty line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹500/- is provided to widows aged 40 to 79 years who are living Below the Poverty Line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life. This scheme is centrally sponsored.

fields.schemeName: New Charkha-Loom Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides 65% financial assistance for purchasing Amber Charkhas (₹13,000/-) and looms (₹30,000/-) to registered Khadi spinners and weavers, promoting sustainable livelihoods.

fields.schemeName: Meghalaya Goat Farming Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Meghalaya Goat Farming Development Scheme is a component of the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program, launched by the Govt of Meghalaya. It aims to employ, engage, and empower youth and rural communities by promoting goat farming entrepreneurship, providing easy access to credit and subsidies.

fields.schemeName: Meghalaya Poultry Farming Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Meghalaya Poultry Farming Scheme is a component under the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program launched  by the Government of Meghalaya. It aims to employ, engage, and empower the youth and rural communities by  promoting poultry entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies.

fields.schemeName: Chief Ministers Green Taxi Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme promotes clean mobility and electric vehicle adoption in the Greater Shillong Planning Area, while supporting green entrepreneurship and sustainable transport through financial incentives.

fields.schemeName: Poultry Farming Scheme (HSFDC)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural and urban areas for self-employment income generating activities such as poultry farming.

fields.schemeName: Trade and Business Sector Scheme (HSFDC)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from BPL families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural & urban areas for various self-employment income-generating activities such as running a stationery shop, kiryana shop, cloth shop, etc.

fields.schemeName: The Scheme for Fellowship to Under Graduate Students for Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University
fields.briefDescription: "The Scheme for Fellowship to Under Graduate Students for Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University" provides monthly fellowship to meritorious undergraduate students across various faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University.

fields.schemeName: Planning for Best Livestock Keeper's Award Function
fields.briefDescription: The "Planning for Best Livestock Keeper's Award Function" scheme by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department honors outstanding pastoralists in Gujarat by awarding them at Taluka, District, and State levels for their excellence in animal husbandry.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Cultivation of Medicinal/ Aromatic Crops
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance up to 75% of the cost or ₹11,250/- per hectare (whichever is lower) to farmers in Gujarat cultivating medicinal or aromatic crops on land between 0.20 and 4 hectares.

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC- Haryana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme offers educational loans of up to ₹10 lakhs for studies within India and up to ₹20 lakhs for studies abroad. These loans are available to eligible students pursuing regular full-time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad.

fields.schemeName: Trainning Scheme for Horticulture Skill Development to Landless farm labour at Centre of Excelence of Department
fields.briefDescription: The "Training Scheme for Horticulture Skill Development to Landless Farm Labour at Centre of Excellence of Department" aims to provide skill development training in horticulture to landless farm labourers through the Centres of Excellence.

fields.schemeName: 100% State Government Divyangjan Term Loan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides provide financial support to native residents of Gujarat who have a disability of 40% or more. The eligible individuals can avail of a term loan ranging from ₹50,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- at a concessional interest rate of 6% per annum for a repayment period of five years.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Destitute Elderly and Disabled Person
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Destitute Elderly and Disabled Person" provides monthly financial aid to elderly individuals (60+) and severely disabled persons who meet specific income and dependency criteria.

fields.schemeName: Passenger Vehicle/Loading Vehicle Loan Scheme (DAADC)
fields.briefDescription: The "Passenger Vehicle/Loading Vehicle Loan Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides financial support to unemployed individuals from Antyodaya Caste for purchasing passenger or freight vehicles.

fields.schemeName: New Akanksha Scheme (Higher Education Loan) (GGDC)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides educational loans of up to ₹15.00 lakh to students belonging to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from socially and educationally backward classes for pursuing higher professional courses such as medical, dental, engineering, pharmacy, etc.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Sahay for the Preparation of NEET, JEE, GUJCET Examination to both Socially and Educationally Backward Class Trainees/Students and Female Students and Economically Backward Class Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC) and Economically Backward Class (EBC) students with coaching fee assistance. Up to ₹20,000 or actual fee is provided for one exam preparation.

fields.schemeName: Special Incentive Assistance to Socially and Educationally Backward Class Trainees for Pre-preparation of Competitive Examination
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, to provide financial assistance of up to ₹20,000/- to socially and educationally backward class students preparing for state and central government job exams.

fields.schemeName: Maintenance of Govt Boys and Girls Hostels (SC)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, it provides free hostel, food, and academic facilities to scheduled caste students pursuing post-SSC education.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance for the Production and Publication of Excellent Original Children's Literature
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote high-quality literary works for children by providing financial support to Gujarati authors for publishing original, unpublished children's books that contribute to cultural and moral development.

fields.schemeName: One Tea Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the One Tea Scheme is to ensure a minimum guaranteed price for fresh tea leaves to protect tea farmers from financial losses and provide economic stability. It also aims to support bought-leaf factories and promote sustainable tea cultivation in Meghalaya.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Samarth-Respite Care Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Samarth (Respite Care) scheme, launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, aims at setting up Samarth Centres for providing respite and residential care for the specified categories of Persons with Disability (PwD).

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Pre- Matric Scholarships Scheme for Scheduled Castes & Others
fields.briefDescription: The Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Castes & others is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana- SEBC & EBC
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide marriage-related financial aid of ₹12,000 per daughter (up to two daughters per family) to socially and educationally backward classes and economically backward class families.

fields.schemeName: Kutirjyoti Yojana Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free household electricity connections to Scheduled Tribe families in tribal areas.

fields.schemeName: Visiting Advanced Joint Research Faculty Scheme
fields.briefDescription: VAJRA Faculty Scheme is a dedicated program exclusively for overseas scientists and academicians with emphasis on NRI and Persons of Indian Origin/Overseas Citizen of India to work as adjunct/visiting faculty for a specific period of time in Indian Public funded academic and research institutions.

fields.schemeName: SERB International Research Experience
fields.briefDescription: The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), a statutory body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India has launched "SERB International Research Experience (SIRE)".

fields.schemeName: SERB Research Scientist Scheme
fields.briefDescription: SERB Board has launched a new ‘SERB Research Scientist (SRS) Scheme’ for the awardees of INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellowships, who fail to secure regular positions after completion of the regular tenure of five years in the respective schemes.

fields.schemeName: J.C. Bose Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The “J.C. Bose fellowship” is awarded to active scientists in recognition of their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective.

fields.schemeName: National Energy Conservation Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and reward organizations for their exemplary efforts in energy conservation and energy efficiency.

fields.schemeName: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the award is to motivate vaidyas and Ayurveda experts to adopt and showcase best practices in Ayurveda, promoting high standards of excellence. The award also aims to encourage innovation and outstanding performance in the field through healthy competition.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: New Swarnima Scheme For Women
fields.briefDescription: A term loan scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for women entrepreneurs from backward classes to obtain a loan of up to ₹ 2,00,000/- @ 5% per annum, thereby providing them social & financial security.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Dairy Development Scheme Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, tribal women beneficiaries are provided with milch cattle, dairy equipment, and financial assistance of up to ₹90,000 per unit.

fields.schemeName: Rastriya Arogya Nidhi - Health Minister’s Cancer Patient Fund
fields.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to provide financial assistance to poor patients living below the poverty line and suffering from cancer, for their treatment at 27 Regional Cancer Centers (RCCs).

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package : Insurance Scheme For Health Workers Fighting COVID-19
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial protection through insurance cover of ₹50,00,000/- to healthcare workers fighting COVID-19.

fields.schemeName: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Consolidation of Coffee" aims to increase the productivity of the existing coffee holdings by gap filling or rejuvenation, followed by improved cultivation methods such as application of compost, bush management, shade management, pest and disease control, etc.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship Scheme for Girl Children of Workers of Jute Mills/MSME JDP Units
fields.briefDescription: National Jute Board Act, 2008 provides to “secure better working conditions and provisions and improve amenities and incentives for workers engaged in the jute industry.”

fields.schemeName: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana (Scholarship For Promotion Of Aptitude & Research In Stamps As A Hobby)
fields.briefDescription: "Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana" awards annual scholarships to students who have good academic records and are also pursuing 'Philately' as a hobby. The objective is to “Promote Philately among children at a young age in a sustainable manner that can reinforce and supplement the academic curriculum.

fields.schemeName: Pension Scheme to Disabled Persons (Divyangjan)- DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department to provide financial assistance to individuals with disabilities. The primary objective is to provide financial benefits to eligible Divyangjan to cater to their basic needs. The scheme is targeted at Divyangjan aged between 18 to 59 years.

fields.schemeName: Varishtha Pension Bima Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a pension scheme for senior citizens. Through this scheme, immediate annuity, pension, and return of purchase price on death are provided to citizens aged 60 years and above.
tags: Return Of Purchase Price On Death

fields.schemeName: Integrated Child Development Services Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In Nagaland, the ICDS programme was launched in the year 1975 in the Jalukie block of Peren district with 50 Anganwadi centres. The programme has since grown and at present, there are 60 (sixty) ICDS projects in 11 (Eleven) districts of the State.

fields.schemeName: LLB Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: Department of Justice introduced an Internship Programme for young law students. The purpose is to well acquaint law students in the field of research & referencing work, in various specialized areas of justice delivery, such as Tele-Law, Nyaya Bandhu etc.

fields.schemeName: Good Samaritan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 3rd Oct 2021 by the MoRTH, the scheme grants an award to the good samaritan who has saved the life of a victim of a fatal accident (involving a motor vehicle) by administering immediate assistance and rushing to the Hospital/Trauma Care Centre within the Golden Hour of the accident.

fields.schemeName: National Scheme Of Incentive To Girls For Secondary Education
fields.briefDescription: The National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education promotes the girl child's enrolment of 14-18 years age group at secondary stage, who passes class 8th and subsequently drops out for various socio-economic reasons.

fields.schemeName: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child
fields.briefDescription: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is a Fellowship Scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education, for pursuing research work leading to the award of a Ph.D. degree. The target group of this scheme is the ‘single girl child'.
